name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Self-Shadowing (T_light)
definition: Calculates the self-shadowing transmittance $T_{light}$ for each Gaussian along the sun direction. It represents the 'front occlusion transmittance' to model self-shadowing effects in volume rendering.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Self-Shadowing (T_light) calculates front occlusion transmittance from the light's perspective to enable physically plausible shadows, differing from standard alpha blending by tracking accumulated occlusion rather than camera-based blending.
